label: IFrame
description: An embedded browser iframe acts as the trust boundary. Cross-origin messaging is constrained by browser sandboxing and postMessage origin checks.

label: CSP
description: Content Security Policy. Browser-enforced restrictions on script execution, frame ancestors, and resource origins. See [CSP reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/HTTP/CSP).

label: Azure
description: Azure-tenant or Azure-subscription-scoped boundary using VNet isolation, Private Link, RBAC, and Azure Policy.

label: User browser
description: The user's browser process itself is the boundary — content and data within the page are subject to the same-origin policy and end-user device security.

label: User Tenant Trust Boundary
description: Trust boundary between the end user and their tenant — separates user-controlled context (identity, device, session) from tenant-controlled resources, policies, and data governance.
